title: He commanded soldiers.
paragraphs:
He commanded soldiers.
But he recognized when he was standing in front of Someone greater.
What kind of strength knows when to submit?

Real authority doesn’t compete.
It recognizes.

Matthew 8 shows us something rare —
power that kneels without losing strength.

The centurion didn’t need Jesus to come to his house.
He understood authority.

Some people need proof.
Others recognize presence.
